ProbabilityTheory.IsUniform.measureReal_.statement: Let $U$ and $V$ be measurable, independent random variables, with $U$ uniformly distributed on the finite set $A$ and $V$ uniformly distributed on the finite set $B$. Then $P[U-V=0]=\dfrac{|A\cap B|}{|A|\cdot|B|}$.
ProbabilityTheory.IsUniform.measureReal_.sketch: One decomposes the event $U=V$ over the common values $s$, uses independence to write $P[U=s,V=s]=P[U=s]P[V=s]$, and evaluates each factor as $1/|A|$ or $1/|B|$ for $s\in A\cap B$ (and $0$ otherwise) using the unit test for uniform distributions.

ProbabilityTheory.IsUniform.measureReal_.statement: Let $U$ and $V$ be measurable, independent random variables, with $U$ uniformly distributed on the finite set $A$ and $V$ uniformly distributed on the finite set $B$. Then for every $x\in G$, $P[U-V=x]=\dfrac{|A\cap (B+\{x\})|}{|A|\cdot|B|}$.
ProbabilityTheory.IsUniform.measureReal_.sketch: Apply the case $x=0$ to $U$ and $V+x$, which is uniformly distributed on $B+\{x\}$ (a set of the same size as $B$) and still independent of $U$.

rdist_le_of_isUniform_of_card_sub_le.statement: Let $A\subseteq G$ be nonempty with $|A-A|\le K|A|$, and let $U_0$ be a measurable random variable uniformly distributed on $A$. Then $d[U_0;U_0]\le \log K$.
rdist_le_of_isUniform_of_card_sub_le.sketch: Taking an independent copy, $d[U_0;U_0]$ is expressed through $H[U_0-U_0']-H[U_0]$; the difference takes values in $A-A$, so its entropy is at most $\log|A-A|$, while $H[U_0]=\log|A|$ by the entropy formula for uniform variables, giving the bound $\log(|A-A|/|A|)\le\log K$.

PFR_conjecture_aux.statement: Let $A$ be a nonempty subset of $G$ (an elementary abelian $2$-group, per the docstring) with $|A+A|\le K|A|$. Then there exist a subgroup $H\le G$ and a set $c\subseteq G$ such that $|c|\le K^{13/2}|A|^{1/2}|H|^{-1/2}$, $|H|\le K^{11}|A|$, $|A|\le K^{11}|H|$, and $A\subseteq c+H$.
PFR_conjecture_aux.sketch: Apply the entropic PFR theorem (with $\eta=1/9$) to two copies of a uniform variable $U_A$ on $A$ to get a uniform $U_H$ on a subgroup $H$ with $2d[U_A;U_H]\le 11\,d[U_A;U_A]\le 11\log K$; the entropy bound $|H[X]-H[Y]|\le 2d[X;Y]$ together with $H[U_A]=\log|A|$, $H[U_H]=\log|H|$ gives the size comparison of $H$ and $A$, and a value $x$ with $P[U_A-U_H=x]\ge e^{-H[U_A-U_H]}$ combined with the formula $P[U-V=x]=|A\cap(B+x)|/(|A||B|)$ yields a large intersection $A\cap(H+x)$, from which a covering $A\subseteq c+H$ with the stated bound on $|c|$ is produced.

PFR_conjecture.statement: Let $A$ be a nonempty subset of $G$ (an elementary abelian $2$-group, per the docstring) with $|A+A|\le K|A|$. Then there exist a subgroup $H\le G$ and a set $c\subseteq G$ with $|c|<2K^{12}$, $|H|\le|A|$, and $A\subseteq c+H$.
PFR_conjecture.sketch: It is derived from the auxiliary statement `PFR_conjecture_aux`: the bounds $|c|\le K^{13/2}|A|^{1/2}|H|^{-1/2}$, $|H|\le K^{11}|A|$ and $|A|\le K^{11}|H|$ are converted, with an auxiliary positivity lemma, into a covering by fewer than $2K^{12}$ cosets of a subgroup of size at most $|A|$.
